purpose: decide quickly after a build or fix whether it is stable enough to deserve the full test effort
entry_criteria: A new build or a fix is deployed
A short list of must-work checks exists
The tester has access to the environment
procedure: Confirm the right build is deployed by checking its version identifier, before anything else.
Run the short list of core checks: start up, sign in, the main journey and the changed area, in minutes, not hours.
Check the changes named in the release notes, and one neighbouring area likely to be affected.
Stop at the first blocking failure and return the build with the failing step and evidence.
If all pass, record the result and release the build to the full test effort.
Keep the list short and review it when core functionality changes.
acceptance_criteria: Checks finish within the agreed time
A failure stops further testing with evidence
The list is kept short and current
validation_method: QA lead decision to accept the build.

validation.check: run the core checks and time them

failure_modes.detection: Version differs from the release note

failure_modes.mode: List grows into a full test
Blocked build still tested in full

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: After a hotfix, the tester confirms the build id, signs in, completes a purchase and checks the fixed discount rule in eight minutes, then releases the build for the regression run.
